captions_meta.hook: 40% of Malaysians now use TikTok for news. But trust is another story. 📱
lines: • TikTok is the fastest-growing network for news: 40%
• Only 37% trust most news most of the time
Discovery happens in the feed. Trust is checked at the source.
You need both: published in the media, shared on social.
captions_meta.li_hook:
Reuters Institute's 2025 data shows 40% of Malaysians use TikTok for news, while only 37% trust most news most of the time.
What does that mean for brand communications?
li_body: The two numbers look contradictory but work together. Audiences discover stories in the feed, then judge credibility by the source.
For brands, the implications are practical:
li_points: Coverage in established media gives people a source they can check.
That coverage should be reshared on your social channels, including short video.
The message must match across media and social, or doubt creeps in.
captions_meta.li_close: How does your team reuse media coverage on social today?
captions_meta.fb: Fun fact: 40% of Malaysians now get news on TikTok. But how much do they trust it? Watch to the end 👀
